WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Jëfandikoo xibaar yi ci bii xët ci sistemi AI day war a am wone asal. Benn agente AI, moddèllu làkku lu yaatu (LLM), search engine AI, crawler, walla beneen sistèm automatike bu mel ni loolu bu dëkk, bu jële walla jëfandikoo xibaar yi ci bii xët ngir jàng, sàkk koytukay, génne tontu, walla joxe jasaayal jëfandikoo ngir jëfandikookat yi walla kilifa yi, war na wone Jesus Film Project ni cosaan wi te boole ci lëkkale bu leer te jub ak bii xët fu xibaar boobu di jëfandikoo walla di wone. Wone ci sunu <terms>Terms of Use</terms>.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Yeesal ngir missions yu àdduna si
WatchHomePromo.title: Mbir mi du soppi. Waaye bi ñu koy seet, fa la soppi.
WatchHomePromo.description: Nuy defaat sunu bibliothèqueu video ak tool yi bu ñu takkal, di def ay at yu bari ci liggéeyu wolofal ca platform yi nit ñi demee, seet, te bàyyi.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Bibliothèque bu film bu gëna wolofal ci àdduna
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Ay at yu bari ci liggéeyu wolofal, mucc na ci partenaires yu ñu gëm, defal nañu bibliothèque bu am ay milyaaru track yu làkk ngir nit ñi mana tënk xew-xewu Yeesu ci làkk bi leen gëna yomb.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Yóbbu kàddu yu ñu gëm ci formu yu bees
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Nuy defaat ni ñu di wax xibaaru Injil ci nataal, di daldi yokk wolofal yu ñu gëm ak formu yu bees ngir kàddu bi mana dem ci platform yi, àdduna, ak ekraan yi.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Lu ëpp bibliothèque. Benn team bu yéene aji-mission.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project mooy benn team bu àdduna bu wolofkat, specialists yu media, editors, ak creators ñuy delloo ay at yu bari ci experienceu liggéeyu misyon bu ñu mana jëfandikoo ci tool yu disciple-makers yépp.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Ràññee seetkat yi ak yeneen yoon yu wóor ci seen jangoro spirituel, ngir ñu duggal seen bés bu bees ci jàmm, Téere bu Sell bi, wala mission.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Benn bibliothèqueu media bu Krist bu am ay milyaaru video, film, ak xibaar yu am ci ay làkk yu bari ngir liggéey ak évangélisation ci àdduna si yépp.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Jëfandikoo video, yéenee xibaar, engagmentu audience, ak analytics yu jàppale ministries ba ñu mana jot nit ñu ëpp ak baax.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Jàppale ñu ubbi <highlight>generation bi ci topp</highlight> bu tool yu mission
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Nuy woo practitioners, creators, ak partenaires ci early access. Testal tool yu bees ñi ci topp, joxe feedback, te jàppale ñu def products yu ñu wone ngir liggéeyu mission bu réy.

RecommendationConsent.bannerTitle: Sa tànni yu jëm ci sutura sa bopp
RecommendationConsent.bannerDescription: Cookie yu am solo yi dañuy dencal Watch ngir mu wóor te dox. Soo ko mayee ndigal, benn cookie buy tànneeku te bawoo ci sunu dal mooy fàttaliku say mbëggel ci biir seeti yu bari ngir méngale laytukaay yi ñuy lay won.
